Basics

Frozen herb cubes

Fűszerkockák

6 months+ Replaced 15 min 12 portions

From 6 months, stirred into a hot meal. Do not keep the blended paste for a week, and do not add salt for an older child either.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 20 g fresh parsley and dill (washed; herbs, not a salty mix)
  • 1 ripe tomato (chopped)
  • 1 small sweet pepper (seeds removed)
  • a splash water (only to blend; no salt)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Wash the herbs, tomato, and sweet pepper.
  2. Blend them with a splash of water until smooth, adding no salt.
  3. Pour into an ice tray at once.
  4. Freeze the same day rather than keeping a raw paste in the fridge.
  5. Thaw a cube in the fridge and use it within two days, or stir it into hot food from frozen.

Replaced

The usual seasoning paste was raw vegetables kept for a week in the fridge, and salt was suggested for older children.

Blend herbs, tomato, and sweet pepper and freeze them at once in ice cubes, with no salt. Keep a thawed cube for two days in the fridge at most.
